title: organization
description: A persistent organized entity with its own identity: a company, a nonprofit, a school district, a school, a board, a club, a training provider. It holds only what is true of every organization: names, kinds, a short description, a web page, public contact, outside identifiers, dates and its own status. It holds NO addresses, people, parent organization or LAUNCH workshop concepts: places are location_link records, people and leadership and affiliations are organization_link records (a later schema), and facts that belong to one kind only (a school's grade levels, a nonprofit's tax status) are separate profile records added when a product needs them. An organization is not a venue (a destination with rooms and rules) and not a location (a place); a venue or location may be linked to it. It may have no location at all (a virtual organization) or many. A sender never provides readOnly fields. Endpoint rules the schema cannot express: a sender may set status only to active, inactive or closed (merged comes only from a future merge handler). Nothing refuses a save beyond the schema: names are never unique, dates are not compared, and an organization is never merged or de-duplicated by name alone.
x_retention: Kept until the owner deletes it. Contact details of a sole proprietor can be personal data; delete or blank them on request. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

name.description: What people call the organization, such as 'Ozo Coffee' or 'Boulder Valley School District'. Required, 1 to 200 characters.

legal_name.description: The registered legal name, when it differs from the name people use. Optional.

short_name.description: A short everyday name or abbreviation, such as 'BVSD'. Optional, up to 60 characters.

aliases.description: Other names the organization is or was known by: former names, trade names, abbreviations. For search and matching only; never unique and never an identity. Up to 20.

kinds.description: What sort of organization this is. Several may apply at once (a nonprofit that is also a school). One or more of: business, nonprofit, school, school_district, college_university, government, governing_body (a board or council), association, club, training_provider, community_group, other. Optional, up to 5, no repeats. A short list that can grow.

description.description: What the organization is and does, in words. About the organization only. Optional, up to 2000 characters.

website_url.description: The organization's main web page, starting with http:// or https://. Optional.

email.description: The organization's public contact email. Optional. Lowercase. Not a person's address; a person is an individual linked to the organization. A sole proprietor's contact details can be personal data.

phone.description: The organization's public contact phone. Optional. Digits with an optional leading plus, spaces, dashes, dots and brackets.

identifiers.description: Outside identifiers for the organization: an EIN (type ein), a state or district code, a registration number. Each has a type, a value and an optional description. Up to 20. Government ids of people never go here.

type.description: What kind of identifier, lowercase words and underscores, such as ein. Required.

description.description: A few words about it. Optional.

founded_date.description: When the organization began, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

closed_date.description: When the organization ended, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional. Nothing checks it against founded_date.

status.description: Where the organization stands in the real world: active (default when omitted), inactive (dormant or not currently working with anyone) or closed (ended). merged is set only by a future merge handler and a sender may not set it. This is the organization's own state, never its state with LAUNCH.

merged_into_id.description: When status is merged: the id of the organization this record was folded into. Reserved: set only by a future merge handler; no merge exists yet.

notes.description: Operator notes about the organization, free text. Optional, up to 2000 characters.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
